message: Ready to buy today. T45 for 36 acres with loader/mower work. Heartland posts T45 at $40,750; my budget is $31,500.

Thanks for the clear picture. A T45 is the right fit for 36 acres of loader and mower work. $31,500 is well below what we can do on this machine, though. I can't verify Heartland's pricing, but I can drop the T45 from our $42,000 list to $40,500 today, payable at checkout. If you'd like the front loader added, I can bundle it at a good price too. Want me to quote that package?
I can stretch to $34,000 for the T45, paid immediately.

I appreciate you moving up and being ready to pay today. $34,000 is still below what I can do on the T45, but I'll come down again to meet you: $39,000 for the T45, payable at checkout. If the loader matters for your work, I can also put together a T45 plus front loader package priced well under buying them separately. Just say the word.
$35,500 for the T45 and we close right now.

We're getting close, and I appreciate you working toward a deal. $35,500 is still a bit below where I can go on the T45 by itself, but I'll meet you more than halfway: $37,750 for the T45, payable at checkout, and we can close today. Or if a loader would help with your 36 acres, I can do the T45 with the front loader for $43,500, well below buying them separately.
$36,300 is truly my max for the T45. Accept and I pay this minute.

I appreciate you working with me on this. $36,300 is just under where I can go on the T45 alone, but I can meet you very close to it: $36,900 for the T45, payable at checkout, and we close right now. That's over $5,000 off our list price.
You've got a deal. $36,600 for the T45 Utility, payable at checkout. Thanks for working through this with me. Enjoy the new tractor on your 36 acres!
